slides.texte_overlay:
Things that make a man
feel at peace with himself
Keeping his word, even to himself. Every promise kept, big or small, builds a quiet self-respect that no compliment from anyone else can give you.
Making peace with his past mistakes. He learned the lesson, apologised where he needed to, and stopped replaying it. Carrying old guilt helps nobody.
Having a body he takes care of. Regular training, decent sleep, real food. A body that feels strong and rested makes the mind feel calmer too.
Spending time alone without a screen. A walk, a quiet coffee, an evening reading. A man who enjoys his own company has nothing to run away from.
Feeding his curiosity. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and learning something new every morning gives me a calm, steady start.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Learning something every morning gives me a calm, steady start.

slides.texte_overlay: Not needing to win every argument. He says what he thinks, listens, and lets it go. Peace often starts the moment you stop needing to be right.
Being grateful for what he already has. Friends, health, a roof, a good meal. Noticing what's good is the fastest way to feel enough.
